scope: Synthetic fixtures, actual compiled bundles, 110 independent desktop Node/V8 measurement processes plus 22 separate allocation probes. Not Loon/iPhone or VPN memory acceptance.
method: Five fresh uninstrumented processes per version/case; alternated order; fixed clock/random; one invocation per process; GC before measurement. peakRSSKiB is whole-process lifetime high-water RSS, including Node/fixture setup. Heap/ArrayBuffer growth is sampled at store writes and completion, not a continuous peak. Array constructors are instrumented ONLY in separate diagnostic processes; those timings/RSS are excluded. Allocation counts exclude native encoders, internal views and host buffers. All outputs and persisted records are byte-compared by SHA-256. Cases with identicalBundle are controls, not optimization gains.
